strings.초시공 네트워크 안으로 %s 님의 새로운 기억들이 발견돼서 메시지를 드렸: I sent you a message because new memories of yours were detected in the hyperspace network, %s. Please access it again, as you did last time...
strings.자고 왔지만, 그래도 피곤한가 봐요. 여러 가지 일이 겹쳐서…. 이제 괜: I did get some sleep, but I must still be tired. So many things have happened at once... I should be all right now...
strings.최근에 무슨 일을 겪으셨는지 말씀해주실 수 있나요?: Could you tell me what you have experienced recently?
strings.(사라스바티에게 엘리시아에 다녀온 이야기를 한다.): (You tell Sarasvati about your visit to Elysia.)
That is hard to believe... To think there is yet another world...
strings.하긴, 제가 파악한 세계도 여러 개인데, 그런 소리를 하다니…. 관리자로: Though I have identified several worlds myself, so I should not say that... Not as an administrator...
strings.아하하…, 그러면 저번처럼 이렇게 손을 대면 되는 건가?: Ahaha... Then do I just place my hand here, like last time?
strings.지금 그 일을 할 수 없다고 에러 메시지가 출력되는군요. 로그를 확인해: An error message says the operation cannot be performed right now. Checking the logs, it seems certain conditions must be met.
strings.프뉴마에 있던 시간의 정령이 헤카테란 신이 일으킨 일에 의해 잠깐, 아주: The spirit of time in Pneuma stopped for a moment, a very brief moment, because of something the god Hecate did. That caused time in Etoile to waver.
And the spacetime network was affected too, though only very slightly.
I would like you to ask Elysia's administrator.
strings.혹시 모르지만, 제가 조건을 변경할 수 있는지 알아보겠습니다. 그래도 한: I will see whether I can change the conditions, just in case. But please visit Elysia once...
If you are reluctant, you do not have to do it.
strings.괜찮아요, 다녀올게요…. 그런데 뭐라고 물어보죠?: It's all right. I'll go... But what should I ask?
Hmm... 'Memories' seems like a good keyword.
All right, Sarasvati. I'll go right away.
I thought you would return someday, but I did not expect it to be so soon.
I somehow felt I needed to come back.
strings.솔직하지 못하군. 그런 기분에 대한 답이 될지 모르겠지만, 내가 약간 도: You are not being honest. I do not know whether this will answer that feeling, but I will help you a little.
I am speaking now, am I not? Listen quietly.
strings.자네는 쥬드 왕국에서 있었던 일을 어떻게 기억하고 있나?: How do you remember what happened in the Jude Kingdom?
I went from Freios to Eastland to find Iris. And then...
strings.그러다 쥬드 왕국에서 어떤 일을 겪었나?: What did you experience in the Jude Kingdom?
I confronted the chief of the Agni clan, who had been used by Ban and Mara... Wait...
No, I was... of the Agni clan...
Even when you came to Elysia, you did not recognize your identity as an Agni.
strings.자네의 선택에 따라 내가 도울 수도 있네. 일족의 족장이었던 내가 후손을: Depending on your choice, I may be able to help. As a former chief of the clan, it is only natural that I help a descendant.
You seem unwilling. Then go back.
No. That's not it... I'll do it.
strings.다시 한번 말하지만, 자네의 선택이지. 그리고 난 약간의 도움을 줄 뿐이: Again, this is your choice. I am merely offering a little help.
I never expected to find a descendant like you... But it cannot be helped.
strings.이스트랜드의 물건을 몇 개 구해오게. 그 물건들이 엘리시아에서 자네의 잊: Bring me a few objects from Eastland. Here in Elysia, they will awaken your forgotten memories.
strings.[태양신의 지하제단]에서 숨겨져 있는 [아그니의 마나 홀]을 잔뜩 가져오: Bring plenty of the [Agni Mana Holes] hidden in the [Sun God's Underground Altar]. Those objects, filled with the will of flame, should suffice.
Then I will tell you what to bring next.
strings.이 마나 홀은 태양신 아그니의 힘, 그중 근원이 될만한 것들이 물질화된: These Mana Holes are the materialized power of Agni, the sun god. They contain something close to its very source.
The ones you brought glow a deeper red than the Mana Holes I know.
strings.고대신이 머물렀던 엘리시아가 자네에게 선물을 준다고 생각하고…, 가지고: Think of it as a gift from Elysia, where the ancient gods once dwelled... Press the Mana Holes you brought against your chest.
I would like to call your suspicion prudence, but it does not suit an Agni.
strings.(마나 홀이 %s의 가슴에 닿는 순간, 타오르고 있던 결정이 불꽃으로 변: (The moment the Mana Hole touches %s's chest, the burning crystal turns into flame and plunges inside.)
M-My head is burning. I... I...
strings.아그니 일족이 두려움을 극복하는 방법일세. 두려워하지 말게. 자네만의 영: This is how the Agni clan overcomes fear. Do not be afraid. Think of it as your own soul awakening...
strings.이제 됐겠지. 뭔가 떠오르나?: That should do. Does anything come to mind?
strings.반과 마라가 마을을 습격했을 때, 아버지께서 저를 숨겨진 비밀 제단으로: When Ban and Mara attacked the village, my father told me to escape to a hidden, secret altar... He said he would save the village as its chief...
And so I went to the sacred land, and by the will of the goddess Seres, began my journey...
strings.성계신이 될 그분을 찾는 여행의 시작이었군. 그래서 쥬드 왕국에 왔을 때: The beginning of your journey to find the one who would become God of the Astral Realm. So what happened when you reached the Jude Kingdom?
strings.일족이 반과 마라의 마석 때문에 쥬드 왕국을 습격했고, 아버지께선 일족을: The clan attacked the Jude Kingdom because of Ban and Mara's magic stones. To save the clan, my father had no choice...
strings.영혼의 일부가 아그니인 걸 인식하지 못하는 걸 보니 한 번 더 다녀와야겠: You still do not recognize that part of your soul is Agni. You will have to make another trip.
strings.시대를 초월해서 이따금 허무의 별에서 나타나는 뱀이 있지. 뱀 그림자라고: There is a snake that appears from time to time on the Star of the Void, across the ages. The Snake's Shadow, was it? You defeated its most recent appearance, correct?
strings.생전 나도 그 뱀을 본 적이 있는데, 영혼을 삼키려고 입맛 다시는 모습은: I saw that snake once during my lifetime. The way it licked its lips, eager to devour souls, was quite memorable. It soon concealed itself, though...
strings.스스로 영혼을 삼켰다고 이야기했으니, 그런 뱀의 물건이라면 자네를 도와줄: It said itself that it had swallowed souls. Something belonging to such a snake may be able to help you.
strings.허무의 별에 다녀오면 아직 남아있는 게 있을 걸세. 마나 홀처럼 넉넉하게: If you visit the Star of the Void, something should still remain. Bring plenty, as you did with the Mana Holes.
What are you standing there for? Be grateful this is not a trial...
strings.자네의 힘으로 뱀 그림자의 뿔과 비늘을 섞어 가루로 만들게. 자네의 기간: Use your power to combine the Snake's Shadow's horns and scales and grind them to powder. The heat flowing from your Gigant Pole should be sufficient.
strings.그리고 뜨거운 사막의 모래 같은 영혼이 깨어나길 빌면서 가루를 두 손에: Then gather the powder in both hands and pray for your soul, like the hot sands of the desert, to awaken.
strings.(이르판의 말대로 뱀 그림자의 뿔과 비늘을 가루로 만들어 손에 모은다.): (As Irfan instructs, you grind the Snake's Shadow's horns and scales to powder and gather it in your hands.)
strings.(손안에 있던 가루가 불꽃으로 변해 그대로 %s의 팔을 타고 올라가 머리: (The powder in your hands turns to flame, racing up %s's arms toward the head.)
strings.겁먹지 말게. 영혼의 영향을 받아 자네가 품은 태양의 불꽃이 정화의 불꽃: Do not be frightened. Under your soul's influence, the sun's flame within you has merely ignited as a purifying flame.
Your memories from that time have awakened...
Irfan, why did I... My father... My father...
Do not be alarmed. Listen to me.
strings.새롭게 정리된 시간에선 아슬란이 기회를 얻었네. 모든 상황에 의문이 생겼: In the newly arranged timeline, Aslan was given a chance. You must have wondered about it all. About the strange behavior of people in the Jude Kingdom...
strings.쥬드 왕국 국왕은 친구인 아슬란을 용서하고, 감옥에서 자숙하는 방향으로: The king of the Jude Kingdom forgave his friend Aslan and showed mercy, allowing him to reflect on his actions in prison.
He had cooperated with the enemy, but what happened was not Aslan's doing...
strings.그 시간에서 자네는 쥬드 왕국의 일을 정리하고 아무렇지도 않게 루맨으로: In that timeline, you settled matters in the Jude Kingdom and headed to Lumen as though nothing had happened.
Yes, that's right. That's what I did... But...
That was you, and the memories now returning are also yours.
I resented the father who helped me escape. I treated him as an enemy and fought him in anger.
I should never have done that. How could I dare do that to my father...
strings.그 시간의 아슬란은 무력했지. 죽고 싶었을 걸세. 사랑하는 자식의 손에서: The Aslan of that timeline was powerless. He must have wanted to die. Even at the hands of his beloved child, he would have wanted to erase the grief of losing his clan.
And so, in that timeline, you killed Aslan and continued your journey.
How could I do that to my father...
strings.하지만, 그 시간은 수정됐지. 자네가 싫어할 수도 있지만, 그 시간의 일: But that timeline was altered. You may not like hearing it, but it was Lady Hecate who changed part of it.
strings.헤카테 님께서 왜 그러셨는지는 나야 모르네. 다만 확실한 건 고대신보다: I do not know why Lady Hecate did so. What is certain is that a being above even the ancient gods wanted that timeline.
Your collapse and downfall, and the destruction of the world...
strings.자네도 알고 있을 걸세. 여러 갈래 시간 속에서 자네는 서로 다른 모습이: You must know as well. Across the branching timelines, you have taken many different forms.
strings.(부정할 수 없어…. 표류도시도 그렇고….): (I can't deny it... There was the Drifting City, too...)
One of those is you, here and now. A descendant of the Agni clan.
The Aslan of this time will not remember you.
When time was altered, Aslan became someone who had no child...
strings.왜… 왜 그렇게 된 거죠?: Why... Why did it turn out that way?
strings.헤카테 님은 그렇다 치지만, 이리스 님께서 자네를 구하기 위해 사용한 능: Lady Hecate's actions aside, the power Lady Iris used to save you became intertwined with them, producing this result.
strings.신은 자기 사람이 아가슈라로 변하는 걸 원치 않지. 그것도 태양신의 후예: A god does not wish her own follower to become an Agasura. Especially if you, a descendant of the sun god, were to change... It could bring about the worst possible outcome.
strings.앞으로 많은 일을 겪을 자네도, 지하 감옥에 갇힌 채로 일족의 재건을 꿈: Things are best as they are, both for you, with so much still ahead, and for Aslan, who dreams of rebuilding his clan from his underground prison.
What do you think would happen if you visited Aslan and told him the truth...?
It would also harm the timeline of Lady Iris, who saved you...
For now, there is no answer. This is the best we can do...
strings.어쨌든 자네는 이 기억을 머릿속에 심은 채로 살아가게. 싫든 좋든 그건: In any case, you must live with these memories planted in your mind. Whether you like it or not, they are part of who you are...
Because we belong to the same clan.
If I were one of my other selves...
Then that would have been a different story.
I hope next time we speak of a new story that is yours alone, instead of this.
It seems you have suffered quite a shock...
strings.자네의 눈물이 당장은 가슴 속 불꽃을 적시겠지만, 그걸 양분 삼아 금방: Your tears may dampen the flame in your heart for now, but it will soon use them as fuel and blaze again...
strings.엘리시아의 관리자에게 답을 얻으셨나요?: Did you receive an answer from Elysia's administrator?
It's a little difficult to explain...
strings.(난처한 %s의 표정에 사라스바티가 알겠다는 듯이 고개를 끄덕인다.): (Seeing %s's troubled expression, Sarasvati nods in understanding.)
It is all right. The problem has been resolved, but whether to use it is your decision.
strings.안전하게 보안 폴더를 따로 만들었습니다. 원하는 시간에 오셔서 액세스하시: I have created a separate secure folder. Come and access it whenever you wish.
strings.그건 그렇고 여전히 모험가님이 지닌 기억이라는 키워드가 역시 초시공 네트: That aside, the keyword 'memories' that you carry still seems to affect the hyperspace network in various ways.
The error corrected itself at some point.
If you access it later, you will be able to review some of your memories.
All right, Sarasvati. I'll head back down now. Goodbye.
Today's adventurer is code name Agni...
